text:
Type: kilim area rug with fringe
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, rustic, traditional
Materials: flat-woven wool or cotton, fringed and tasseled ends
Colors: red, navy blue, cream, tan
Shape: rectangular, horizontal bands of diamonds and southwestern motifs, flat weave, fringe and tassels along ends, thin and light
Feel: warm, lively, earthy
Goes with: cognac leather, dark wood floors, black accents; bohemian or rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Global Bohemian Kilim Rug, 5 x 8 Foot, Multicolor
product.description: This stunning kilim rug will enhance your home decor with an exotic flair. Its beautifully colored and visually engaging design, embellished with fringe accents, will provide an ideal focal point for modern- or bohemian-style interior design. 5' x 8' 78% wool, 22% cotton This handcrafted rug is made by Craftmark-certified artisans, preserving the global craft tradition. The braided-trim detail and extra fringe give this reversible rug a classic look. Flatweave (pile is not applicable) Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
